shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | head -100 && cat AGENTS.md

cat package.json src/App.tsx src/main.tsx tsconfig.json; head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider useThemeValue useTheme SegmentedRadioGroup Switch

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider useThemeValue useTheme SegmentedRadioGroup Switch; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | grep '"version"'

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/* | head -30; grep -n -i -C3 'theme' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -80; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh | head -60
cd /tmp && curl -sS -m 20 -o uikit7.txt -w '%{http_code} %{content_type}\n' https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt; wc -c uikit7.txt; head -c 600 uikit7.txt

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && ls components/theme; cat components/theme/types.d.ts components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts components/theme/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls components/theme/*/ 2>/dev/null; grep -rn -l 'deprecated' components/theme components/SegmentedRadioGroup components/RadioButton 2>/dev/null; grep -n -E 'RadioButton|SegmentedRadioGroup|Switch' index.d.ts components/index.d.ts deprecated.d.ts 2>/dev/null

cat components/theme/useTheme.d.ts components/theme/useThemeType.d.ts components/theme/useThemeValue.d.ts components/theme/ThemeSettingsContext.d.ts components/theme/useThemeSettings.d.ts; ls components/SegmentedRadioGroup; cat components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts components/SegmentedRadioGroup/index.d.ts; ls components | grep -i radio; grep -n 'RadioButton' components/index.d.ts deprecated.d.ts legacy.d.ts

grep -n -A22 'interface ControlGroupProps' components/types.d.ts; grep -n -A8 'interface ControlGroupOption' components/types.d.ts; cat components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroupOption.d.ts; grep -n -E "variant|TextBaseVariant|'subheader-[0-9]'|'header-[0-9]'" components/Text/text/text.d.ts components/Text/Text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -n -E 'gap|direction|alignItems' components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head
